cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I trained you to give a complete handover. What exactly did the manager say about those missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She thinks they're in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better: you've separated her guess from your question. Has anyone actually said they saw me with the keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone saw you outside. She wouldn't tell me who.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly a useful report. Find out what they saw me doing, not just where I was. Then we'll work on your handovers.

reason: Replace the inaccurate verb metaphor and outdoors joke with the specific missing witness detail, keeping A personal answer withheld behind a training correction.
